product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill provides AI agents that help job seekers find and land suitable roles and help employers discover candidates and make warm introductions.

employee_band.notes: The investor reported 25 team members on 2026-09-15; this is the latest directly substantiated headcount found.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains product announcements, hiring advice and marketing content, not at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company’s nine listed openings include no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. Client roles advertised through its recruiting service are excluded. Live listings checked on 2026-11-10; a 2026-11-09 archive was not established.

model_provider.notes: A public documentation review quotes these providers from the company’s Platform Terms, captured 2026-09-25. The currently readable terms page exposes only the job-seeker section, so the provider names are supported by that secondary account of the company’s disclosure.

compliance_certs.notes: No completed certification among the five requested frameworks is claimed on the privacy page. References to UK GDPR rights are legal disclosures, not a certification claim.

raised_18mo.notes: The $40 million Series A was announced on 2026-09-15, within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Account Executive (London) posting checked on 2026-11-10; a 2026-11-09 archive was not established.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ben Slater announced on 2026-10-28 that he had joined as VP B2B Marketing, within the requested twelve-month window.
